start: Trainers page, gym online, a trainer is ticked, a member has PT classes left

steps.action: Open Trainers
user_sees: Title 'Trainers', 'Your trainers, their hours, and personal-training bookings'; each trainer with what they teach and their hours (or 'Working hours not set'); 'Personal training this week'
must_not: A staff person without the Trainer tick listed
Bookings of another branch or gym

steps.action: Tap a trainer
user_sees: The trainer's page: name, 'Trainer', 'Teaches: …' or 'What they teach is not added yet', 'Working hours', 'Bookings this week' with week arrows, their personal-training members
must_not: 'No bookings this week.' while a booking exists
A member listed who is not this trainer's

steps.action: Tap a free time, then in 'Book personal training' search the member, check 'Trainer', 'Day', 'Start time', 'How long', tap 'Book'
user_sees: The member's name with a pill of classes left
Button 'Booking…'
Toast 'Booked: {member} with {trainer}, {day}, {time range}.'; the booking on the week
must_not: Two bookings from two taps
A booking for a member with no classes left
A class taken off the pack at booking time (only 'Mark session' uses one)

steps.action: Tap the booking
user_sees: Sheet '{member} with {trainer}': day and time, classes left, 'Booked by {name}', 'Open member', 'Cancel booking', 'Close'
must_not: Another member's classes shown

start: A trainer's page (entry: edit the trainer's page)

steps.action: Tap the edit button on the trainer's page
user_sees: Sheet 'Edit {name}’s page': 'Photo', 'What they teach' with 'Members and the desk see this. At most 80 letters.', 'Working days', 'Shift starts' / 'Shift ends', 'Second shift starts' / 'Second shift ends', 'The second shift is optional. With no day ticked, every time can be booked.'
must_not: A shift that ends before it starts saved
Different hours per day promised (saving sets the same hours on every ticked day)

steps.action: Pick a photo, type what they teach, tick Monday to Saturday 6 am to 11 am, save
user_sees: The page shows the photo, 'Teaches: …' and the hours; members see the same in their app
must_not: A photo that is not a JPG or PNG saved ('This photo could not be used. Pick a JPG or PNG photo.')
Bookings already made outside the new hours deleted

steps.action: Tap 'Book' with no member, then with no start time
user_sees: 'Pick the member first.' / 'Pick a start time.'
must_not: A booking with no member

steps.action: Pick a time earlier today, then a day 40 days ahead
user_sees: 'This time has already passed. Pick a time later than now.' / 'You can book at most 31 days ahead.'
must_not: A booking in the past

steps.action: Pick a member with no classes left, or with every class left already booked
user_sees: '{member} has no personal-training classes left. Sell a personal-training plan first.' / 'All {n} of {member}’s personal-training classes left are already booked. Sell more first, or cancel a booking.'
must_not: More bookings than classes paid for

steps.action: Pick a time the trainer or the member is already booked
user_sees: '{trainer} already has {member} at {time}. Pick another time.' / '{member} is already booked at {time} that day. Pick another time.'
must_not: Two people booked with one trainer at one time

steps.action: Pick a time outside the trainer's hours
user_sees: A warning 'This is outside {name}’s working hours.' and the button turns into 'Book anyway'
must_not: A silent booking outside hours
No way to book outside hours at all

steps.action: Tap 'Book' with no member, then with no start time

start: A booking on a trainer's week (change a session = cancel and book again)

steps.action: Open the booking, tap 'Cancel booking'
user_sees: 'Cancelling…', then toast 'Booking cancelled.'; the time is free again; the member's classes left are unchanged
must_not: A class used up by a cancelled booking
The booking still shown on the trainer's phone

steps.action: Book the same member at a new time
user_sees: The new booking; one booking only for that class
must_not: Both the old and the new booking alive

steps.action: Open a booking that has already started
user_sees: 'Did they come? Tap "Mark session" on the member’s page.'; the owner can still cancel it
must_not: A session marked by itself because it was booked
Take the Trainer tick off this person: their page says 'This trainer is not on your list any more' and their bookings must not vanish without a word

steps.action: Read what the page shows about members
user_sees: Names of personal-training members, classes left, booking times, who booked
must_not: Members' phone numbers, dues or health notes on a trainer's page
A trainer's own phone number shown to members

start: Trainers page, signed in as front desk

steps.action: Open Trainers, tap a trainer, tap a free time
user_sees: The same list, page and 'Book personal training' sheet as the owner; no edit button on any trainer's page
must_not: An edit button on a trainer's page for the desk
Money figures

steps.action: Search the member, tap 'Book'
user_sees: Toast 'Booked: …'; the sheet of the booking says 'Booked by {this staff person}'
must_not: The booking saved under the owner's name

start: A booking, signed in as front desk or trainer

steps.action: Open a booking that has not started, tap 'Cancel booking'
user_sees: Toast 'Booking cancelled.'
must_not: A used class given back

steps.action: Open a booking that has started
user_sees: No 'Cancel booking' button; 'This booking has started, so only the gym owner can cancel it.'
must_not: Staff cancelling a session that already happened
A cancel that the server refuses after the tap

start: A booking, signed in as front desk or trainer

steps.action: Open a booking that has not started, tap 'Cancel booking'
user_sees: Toast 'Booking cancelled.'
must_not: A used class given back

steps.action: Open a booking that has started
user_sees: No 'Cancel booking' button; 'This booking has started, so only the gym owner can cancel it.'
must_not: Staff cancelling a session that already happened
A cancel that the server refuses after the tap

steps.action: Read the trainers' pages
user_sees: Hours, what they teach, bookings
must_not: Members' progress, questions or complaints (the desk does not read them here)

start: Signed in as a staff person with the Trainer tick

steps.action: Open Trainers, tap your own name
user_sees: Your own page with the edit button; your hours, 'Bookings this week', your personal-training members
must_not: The edit button on another trainer's page
Members who are not yours listed as yours

steps.action: Edit your own page: what you teach and your hours; save
user_sees: Your page and the desk's list show the new hours
must_not: Another trainer's page changed

steps.action: Book one of your members at a free time
user_sees: Toast 'Booked: {member} with {you}, …'
must_not: A booking put on another trainer by mistake (the 'Trainer' box starts on the page's trainer)

start: Trainers list as a trainer (entry: another trainer's page)

steps.action: Tap another trainer's name
user_sees: Their page with hours and bookings, no edit button
must_not: Editing another trainer's hours or photo
Unknown: whether a trainer should see other trainers' members and bookings at all ('A trainer sees only their own members')

steps.action: Read your members list
user_sees: Only members the owner gave you, or who bought a personal-training plan with your name; with none: 'No personal-training members yet. A member shows here when the owner picks this trainer on the member’s page, or sells a personal-training plan with this trainer’s name.'
must_not: Another trainer's members
Members' dues or phone numbers

user_sees: 'Trainer pages need your gym online' and 'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An endless 'Loading…'

steps.action: Open it on a gym whose server does not have this part
user_sees: 'Trainer pages are not ready for your gym yet' and 'MettleUp has not switched on trainer pages and personal-training bookings for your gym yet. Nothing you do here is saved. Message MettleUp on WhatsApp if you want it for your gym.'
must_not: A page that looks working but saves nothing

steps.action: Open #/trainers/{id} of a person no longer a trainer
